review_text: The brew is absolutely delicious, but the agonizingly slow service makes it hard to justify the visit unless you have zero plans for the day. If you are hoping to swing by for a quick morning caffeine fix on your way to work, this is definitely not the place.That being said, once the coffee finally arrived, it was genuinely excellent. The beans are clearly high-quality, the roast is smooth and perfectly balanced, and the barista dialed in the flavor notes beautifully. The product itself is easily five-star quality.

I played here multiple days and the problem still exists. Also, All of their PCs have 16gb ram which is very low for how much their rate costs. You cannot play a game and have anything opened in the background cause it will automatically close the game. Imagine in-game and it closes suddenly cause of low memory error. Their PCs need to be upgraded to 32gb ram, seriously, for how much they charge you for an hour and you cant even enjoy your game.

I’ve been to ZeusX Esports and Cafe a few times already, and overall, I can say the place is decent for gaming and hanging out. I’ve visited three times before and had no major issues, which is why I kept coming back. However, during one visit, I dropped by quickly because I urgently needed to use the restroom. After using the bathroom, I was approached by a female staff member who questioned me—quite rudely—if I had placed an order or was using a PC at that time. I politely told her no, I just badly needed to pee, and ZeusX was the only nearby place where I could do so. I understand policies are in place, but there’s always a better way to approach people—especially in situations like that. Her tone felt unwelcoming and a bit disrespectful. It was happened last July 2,2025 Wednesday between 11:00PM- 12:00AM . You can check your CCTV . On the other hand, I appreciate the male staff who was there at the time—his approach was much more respectful and understanding. Customer service matters a lot, especially when it comes to how staff handle unexpected situations. I hope management can work on improving consistency in how guests are treated. A little courtesy goes a long way.
